Description (Expected vs Actual): Expected: Password policy must enforce a minimum length of 8 characters during registration.         Actual: System allows account creation using a single-character password without validation.
Expected: A "Forgot Password?" link should be available on the login form for account recovery.          Actual: No password recovery options or links are present on the interface.

Expected: Invalid authentication attempts should fail cleanly without triggering browser credential tools.     Actual: The Chrome password manager "Save password?" prompt triggers on a failed login response.

Expected: Entering a malformed email missing '@' should trigger a syntax error ("Please enter a valid email").         Actual: System bypasses syntax check and incorrectly returns "Email Address already exist!".

Expected: Clicking a product category should open the corresponding category page and display products from that category only. Actual: The category navigation is available and category pages are displayed, but the category heading/text shown for the selected subcategory may not match the subcategory selected (for example, the official test case expects a specific category heading).

Expected: Searching for a product should display SEARCHED PRODUCTS and all products related to the entered search term. Actual: The search feature requires entering the product name and clicking the search button; this interaction could not be executed in the current test environment, so the behavior could not be fully verified.

Expected: Product filtering should provide clear conventional filter controls such as price, color, or size when filtering is part of the scope. Actual: No conventional price/color/size filter controls were observed on the Products page; filtering/navigation is mainly provided through Categories and Brands.

Expected: Product category and brand navigation should clearly communicate the selected filter/category to the user. Actual: Category and brand pages use different headings such as category/brand product pages, which can require the user to rely on the page content to understand the active selection.

Expected: After selecting a brand, only products belonging to that brand should be displayed and the user should be able to navigate to another brand page. Actual: Brand navigation is available, but complete multi-brand switching could not be exhaustively executed in the current test environment.

Expected: Every product opened from the Products page should show complete product details including name, category, price, availability, condition, and brand. Actual: The product detail page exposes these fields, but some product-detail pages can appear with sparse/uneven visual content around the details, so the information hierarchy may be less clear than expected.

Expected: A delete button should be provided for each product item within the cart interface.
Actual: No delete option or remove button is displayed to delete items from the cart.

Expected: A decrement control or option should be fully functional to reduce the product quantity in the cart.
Actual: The quantity reduction option is completely missing or unresponsive, preventing users from decreasing item quantities.

Expected: A quick quantity increment control or inline update option should be provided directly within the cart interface to easily increase product quantities.
Actual: Users are forced to navigate back to the product catalog page and repeat the addition process to increase item quantities, resulting in poor user workflow..

Expected: Clear price transparency should be maintained by displaying the original price with a strikethrough alongside the discounted price to explicitly indicate active promotions.
Actual: The discount presentation is ambiguous, failing to display the original crossed-out price or clarifying whether the displayed value represents a valid promotional discount or a static banner element..

Expected: The success confirmation message and input data should remain visible and persistent for an adequate duration, allowing users to verify their submission before the field clears.
Actual: The success notification disappears too quickly and the input field clears automatically within a very short timeframe, preventing users from properly verifying their submitted email.

Expected: System should prompt for complete delivery address before allowing payment processing.
Actual: Checkout allows placing order without entering shipping address details.

Expected: System should prompt for complete delivery address before allowing payment processing.
Actual: Checkout allows placing order without entering shipping address details.

Expected: Payment method selection and 'Place Order' button should be clearly visible on mobile viewports.
Actual: Checkout button is obscured and hidden under footer menu on screen resolution below 768px.

Expected: Order History section should update status in real-time to 'Processing' after payment.
Actual: Completed orders are displayed with 'Pending Payment' status indefinitely in user account history.

Expected: Clear validation error messages should highlight incomplete mandatory fields in checkout form.
Actual: Submission fails without highlighting red borders or showing text errors on invalid zip code input.
